def _find_module(name, path=None):
    spec = importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec(name, path)
    if spec is None:
        raise ImportError(name)
    loader = spec.loader
    if isinstance(loader, importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader):
        return (None, spec.origin, ("", "", imp.PY_SOURCE))
    if isinstance(loader, importlib.machinery.SourcelessFileLoader):
        return (None, spec.origin, ("", "", imp.PY_COMPILED))
    if spec.submodule_search_locations:
        return (None, None, ("", "", imp.PKG_DIRECTORY))
    raise ImportError(name)
imp.find_module = _find_module
imp.new_module = types.ModuleType
imp.source_from_cache = importlib.util.source_from_cache
sys.modules["imp"] = imp
